# NY Nightlife

> Know before you go for New York bars and clubs: dress code, age, cover, hours, and what is on tonight. Facts are sourced and dated. Event listings come from NYC Open Data and, when configured, Ticketmaster Discovery. We do not invent missing facts.

## Start here
- [Tonight](https://nynightlife.com/tonight/): what's on tonight and this week, plus which checked venues are open
- [This weekend](https://nynightlife.com/this-weekend/): Friday 5am through Monday 5am in New York, from the same feeds
- [NYC speakeasies](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-speakeasies.html): hidden doors and walk-in cocktail bars from checked venue pages
- [NYC rooftop bars](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-rooftop-bars.html): hours and dress for the rooftops we have checked
- [New Year's Eve 2026](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-new-years-eve.html): Times Square ball drop and NYE cruises from official pages, no invented prices
- [Venues](https://nynightlife.com/venues/): door facts for the checked bars and clubs
- [Group nights](https://nynightlife.com/plans/): bachelorette prices, boat party, bachelor party, and the cruise guide
- [NYC boat party](https://nynightlife.com/plans/nyc-boat-party.html)
- [Bachelor party](https://nynightlife.com/plans/bachelor-party.html)
- [Comedy clubs](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-comedy-clubs.html)
- [Dress codes](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-dress-codes.html)
- [Closing time](https://nynightlife.com/guides/nyc-bar-closing-time.html)
- [Under 21](https://nynightlife.com/guides/under-21-nyc-bars-clubs.html)
- [How we check](https://nynightlife.com/how-we-check.html)
